ImageDescription.value: Disused office block at the junction of Uxbridge Road and Springfield Road, Hayes Some twenty-five years ago this building was called "Hayes Gate House", the location of a local Tax Office. A sign at the top-left of the building now proclaims it as the "Heathrow Gate Hotel". The erection of blue boarding around the site suggests that redevelopment or demolition is underway.
